# suppression-boundary

The threshold's boundary on both counts. At A, 10 wants for the RTX 3090 are shown and 9 for the
RTX 4090 are not, so that cell is suppressed (both counts null). A's 9 wanted adverts are not
shown although its wants are. At B, 10 adverts are shown and its 1 want is not. Families fall
back to the catalogue ID while product-catalogue is off, the same on both sides
(`want_manager.v_want_terms_by_centre`; `selectAdverts`). Synthetic: no recorded run holds wanted
adverts in these numbers (`PARTS_INTELLIGENCE.md:219`: 0.39% of listings).
